title: Netflix’s One Piece Star Teases Nico Robin’s Future After Season 3 Finale
content: One Piece is readying for its return to Netflix next year with the third season of the live-action series , and the star behind Nico Robin is teasing the character’s future after what’s coming in the next season finale.
author: ComicBook

title: Mobile Suit Gundam Announces Next Big Anime Announcement
content: Mobile Suit Gundam is a mech anime franchise that has found the golden ticket in relation to its longevity. title: Nirvana Just Gave One New Crunchyroll 2027 Anime a Major Boost
content: Crunchyroll has a lot of cool anime now in the works for 2026 and beyond , and one new series coming in 2027 has just gotten a huge boost with a surprising theme song from Nirvana.
author: ComicBook

title: The Ghost in the Shell by Science SARU Reveals Voiced Trailer, New Key Visual
content: Following the premiere of THE GHOST IN THE SHELL on July 7, the anime has released its fourth key visual and sixth trailer, while also launching a new “Episode Visual” project that will accompany each episode throughout the series.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Owl House Shares First Look at Long-Awaited Sequel
content: While Disney has long had an animated history on the silver screen thanks to outings such as Frozen, Moana, The Lion King , and too many others to list, the studio has done the same on the small screen.
author: ComicBook

title: New Gundam Anime Series to Be Revealed on July 23
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks has announced that a brand-new Gundam anime series will be officially unveiled during San Diego Comic-Con 2026 at the “GUNDAM Showcase 2026 – Unveil the Next Gundam” panel on July 23. The panel will take place from 10:30 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kagurabachi Anime Kicks Off World Tour at Anime Expo 2026, Shares Behind-the-Scenes Details
content: The KAGURABACHI anime officially launched its global promotional tour at Anime Expo 2026 in Los Angeles, where fans received the world’s first screening of the opening 20 minutes of Episode 1 alongside a panel featuring lead voice actor Taihi Kimura, manga editor Takuro Imamura, and anime producer Koichi Yasuda.
author: Anime Corner

title: Rudy, Roxy and Sylphie Return to Everyday Life in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 3 Preview
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 3 preview images and synopsis ahead of its July 12 premiere. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga 'Watashi wo Center ni Suru to Chikaimasu ka?' Gets TV Anime
content: Production company Bandai Namco Filmworks opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Jun Wakatsuki 's Watashi wo Center ni Suru to Chikaimasu ka? ( Promise Me the Spotlight ) manga on Wednesday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured).
author: MyAnimeList

title: Red River Anime Casts Minami Takayama, Kazuhiko Inoue as Yuri's Parents
content: The official website for the television anime of Chie Shinohara 's Red River ( Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ) shōjo manga announced on Wednesday that Minami Takayama and Kazuhiko Inoue have joined the anime's cast as the protagonist Yuri's mother and father, respectively.
author: ANN
